The '''Linear Miasma''' was a pocket of space gas, comprised mostly of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], located in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. It was formed when a half million tons of bacta was released from the destruction of the [[B-12 Bacta Transport]] ''[[Suveron]]''. Although it was not suitable for medicinal use anymore, the bacta survived the vacuum of space. This unique phenomenon made the Linear Miasma popular among research communities.<ref name="SWG:TGTLM" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was frequented by the [[Linear Miasma Scientists]], belonging to the [[Endorian Researchers Guild]]. The [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] proved to be a friendly bunch time and time again despite the presence of the [[Spice/Legends|Spice]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]], and the [[Zynt'aia Spice Guardians]], both of whom resided nearby.<ref name="SWG:LM" />
